verdict.rationale: Zep's docs show concrete SDK code (client.graph.edge.delete, thread.add_messages()) and a 'three lines of code' quick-start, plus integrations with major agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc.), indicating a real official SDK for building agent memory into apps. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported languages, links to SDK repos/package registries, and independent hands-on confirmation of SDK usage.
